MiHoYo awarded $112,000 by Chinese court after AI voice service dupes Genshin Impact characters

MiHoYo has scored a legal victory in China after a Shanghai court ordered an unnamed generative AI developer to to pay ¥750,000 (about $112,000) after it found the company inappropriately reproduced and sold the voices of Genshin Impact.

MiHoYo accused the defendant of not only using generative AI to replicate the voices of 63 Genshin Impact characters, but also used "images and story animations" from the game to advertise and sell its illicit voice packs to customers.
